summary: GreenPower Motor Company Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of several related-party transactions in the quarter ended June 30, 2026, collectively increasing shareholder's equity by ~$3.8M. Transactions included: exchange of ~$2.1M in related-party loans and convertible debentures for 2,192 Series B Convertible Preferred Shares (stated value $1,000/share, 9% dividend, convertible at 105% of stated value, ~$1.975/share); conversion of 1,351 Series A Convertible Preferred Shares (~$1.6M liability) into ~1.5M common shares; issuance of 257,638 common shares at $1.44/share to settle $0.4M accrued interest; and exercise of 256,410 warrants at $0.78/share for $0.2M gross proceeds. No outside party involvement, no premium/discount vs market, and no transaction triggering a special-situations classification. These are routine capital-structure adjustments with related parties, not a strategic event. Watch for dilution from future conversions, but no risk-arb angle.
